representations.name: bad-C7 admissible-edge trace hypergraph
representations.new_information: Each bad C7 becomes the exact subset of old edges whose deletion can destroy it.
representations.first_test: Reproduce the binary hitting-pair emptiness on all 3876 round-six configurations.

representations.name: 496-bit binary transversal mask
representations.new_information: Represents every old-edge deletion pair exactly and intersects cycle-incidence masks without relaxation.
representations.first_test: Compare selected masks with direct delete-and-replay on deterministic sample configurations.

representations.name: 4960-bit triple transversal mask
representations.new_information: Tracks all three-edge hitting sets over the thirty-two admissible old edges in one integer.
representations.first_test: Intersect exact masks for eighteen-new-edge configurations and retain every surviving triple.

representations.name: protected-cycle certificate
representations.new_information: Separates bad C7s containing no admissible old edge from obstructions having finite transversal number.
representations.first_test: Count protected-cycle assignments independently of the triple-mask outcome.

representations.name: minimum-transversal profile
representations.new_information: Records whether the exact bad-cycle family has hitting number zero, one, two, three, or exceeds the exchange budget.
representations.first_test: Classify all two-exchange survivors before entering the threshold-preserving triple model.

representations.name: four-state colour replay
representations.new_information: Keeps base, both singleton switches and the joint switch as separately named predicates.
representations.first_test: Replay all four states for each surviving deletion triple.

representations.name: L4 deletion-resilience tensor
representations.new_information: Checks every endpoint pair after every deletion of at most two other vertices.
representations.first_test: Run full L4(2) only after exact C7 transversal filtering.

representations.name: canonical reserve-output ledger
representations.new_information: Distinguishes old reserve membership, switched reserve membership and missing named outputs.
representations.first_test: Verify wz in K(cw) minus K(bc) and uz in K(cu) minus K(bc).

representations.name: locked-cut matching profile
representations.new_information: Computes old and augmented matching rank rather than counting output paths.
representations.first_test: Demand the explicit rank-four allocation wz,uz,bc,cz.

representations.name: threshold exchange budget
representations.new_information: Couples eighteen new incident edges to exactly three old deletions at n=16,e=65.
representations.first_test: Enumerate all choose(19,16)=969 allowed new-edge assignments.
